description: We are a team of students from ITSTEP in Uzhhorod. Our goal is to create a website for modeling a flight to the moon. Combining our different yet great skillsets, we'll produce an incredible project.
summary: Our Lunar Landing Site Navigator is a modern web application that addresses the challenge of lunar expedition landing planning being difficult and unreliable by automating the whole thing. It is extremely important because power and communication availability are everything once a lunar rover lands, and if planned incorrectly - it could render the whole mission useless.
details:
What does it do?
Our project analyses the power and communication availability of a lunar landing site, determining where and when a lunar mission will have the best success.

How does it work?
It works by taking a certain point on the Moon's surface and calculating its power and communication availability via NASA's Horizons System.

Benefits:
- The ability to compare different landing sites based on their scores
- The ability to get a timeline of how a site's conditions change with time
- Beautiful & Accurate 3d visualization

Intended Impract
With this project, we intend to automate the process of lunar landing site planning, making it more reliable and easier to understand for everyone, from a curious child to a professional mission planner at a space agency.

Tools & Software
- VS Code
- JS
- Python
- Antigravity
- Codex

Creativity
Our project shows creativity in the way we visualize our data, showing a model of the Moon-Earth-Sun system making our data easily understandable.

Factors we considered:
Celestial body positions
Lunar geography
